filters.description: Filter group(s). Within a single object, conditions are **ANDed** together. Pass one object for a typical search — multiple objects are reserved for advanced segment combinations.

state.description: Two-letter US state code(s). Any prospect in *one of* these states matches.

naicsList.description: 6-digit NAICS code(s). Common P&C prospect verticals: 484110 (general freight trucking), 236220 (commercial construction), 238210 (electrical contractors), 722511 (full-service restaurants).

ntee.description: IRS NTEE code(s) for nonprofit classification.

prospectName.description: Fuzzy partial match on company name. Use this when you have a known target account.

websiteUrl.description: Website domain or URL. Bare domain (no scheme) is preferred and matches subdomains too.

websiteDomain.description: Exact website domain match (no scheme, no path).

minEmployeesNumber.description: Inclusive lower bound on employee count.

maxEmployeesNumber.description: Inclusive upper bound on employee count. Must be ≥ minEmployeesNumber when both are set.

minSalesVolume.description: Inclusive lower bound on annual sales volume (USD).

maxSalesVolume.description: Inclusive upper bound on annual sales volume (USD). Must be ≥ minSalesVolume when both are set.

hasLinkedin.description: Restrict to prospects with a LinkedIn profile.

hasWebsite.description: Restrict to prospects with a website on file.

hasContactEmailEnriched.description: Restrict to prospects that have had contact emails enriched.

hasWc.description: Restrict to prospects with workers-compensation policy data on file. Strong signal for P&C cross-sell.

hasOsha.description: Restrict to prospects with OSHA inspection/violation records.

hasOshaViolations.description: Restrict to prospects with recorded OSHA violations.

wcCarrierNameList.description: WC carrier name(s) — exact matches within the WC carrier list.

wcBrokerNameList.description: WC broker name(s) — exact matches within the WC broker list.

wcRenewalMonth.description: Single WC renewal month (1–12). Unlike `wcRenewalMonths`, this triggers nearest-x-date sorting so results are ordered by proximity to a target renewal date.

wcRenewalMonths.description: Plain multi-month filter for WC renewal (1–12). Returns prospects whose WC policy renews in any of the listed months. Does not affect sort order — use `wcRenewalMonth` for nearest-date sorting.

hasDot.description: Restrict to prospects with FMCSA/DOT records (trucking, commercial auto). Pair with trucking NAICS for best results.

hasDotmcmxff.description: Restrict to DOT carriers with MX/MF (Mexico cross-border) authority. MCMXFF = Motor Carrier Mexico authority or Form & Fitness.

hasDotViolations.description: Restrict to DOT carriers with recorded violations.

hasDotbipdExcess.description: Restrict to DOT carriers with Bodily Injury & Property Damage (BIPD) excess liability coverage on file.

hasDotbipdPrimary.description: Restrict to DOT carriers with Bodily Injury & Property Damage (BIPD) primary liability coverage on file.

hasDotCargo.description: Restrict to DOT carriers with cargo insurance on file.

hasDotSurety.description: Restrict to DOT carriers with surety bond on file.

hasDotCoverages.description: Restrict to DOT carriers with any DOT coverage on file.

hasDotTrust.description: Restrict to DOT carriers with a DOT Trust filing.

minDotDrivers.description: Inclusive lower bound on number of DOT drivers.

maxDotDrivers.description: Inclusive upper bound on number of DOT drivers.

minDotUnits.description: Inclusive lower bound on number of DOT power units.

maxDotUnits.description: Inclusive upper bound on number of DOT power units.

dotCarrierNameList.description: DOT carrier name(s) — exact matches within the DOT carrier list.

dotbipdMaxLimit.description: Maximum Bodily Injury & Property Damage (BIPD) liability limit on file (USD).

dotbipdExcessRenewalMonth.description: DOT BIPD Excess policy renewal month (1–12).

dotbipdPrimaryRenewalMonth.description: DOT BIPD Primary policy renewal month (1–12).

predictedAutoXMonth.description: Predicted commercial auto policy renewal month (1–12).

predictedGeneralLiabilityXMonth.description: Predicted general liability policy renewal month (1–12).

has5500.description: Restrict to prospects with any Form 5500 welfare/benefits filing.

hasBenefitsPension.description: Restrict to prospects with Form 5500 pension records (defined-benefit pension exposure).

hasBenefitsWelfare.description: Restrict to prospects with Form 5500 welfare plan filings.

has5500Contact.description: Restrict to prospects with a Form 5500 signatory contact on file.

benefitsCarrierNameList.description: Benefits carrier name(s) — exact matches within the 5500 carrier list.

benefitsBrokerNameList.description: Benefits broker name(s) — exact matches within the 5500 broker list.

benefitsRenewalMonths.description: Benefits renewal month(s) (1–12) — matches pension or welfare renewal month.

pensionRenewalMonth.description: Pension plan renewal month (1–12). Triggers nearest-x-date sorting.

welfareRenewalMonth.description: Welfare plan renewal month (1–12). Triggers nearest-x-date sorting.

minPensionParticipants.description: Inclusive lower bound on pension plan participant count.

maxPensionParticipants.description: Inclusive upper bound on pension plan participant count.

minWelfareParticipants.description: Inclusive lower bound on welfare plan participant count.

maxWelfareParticipants.description: Inclusive upper bound on welfare plan participant count.

minBenefitsTotalAssets.description: Inclusive lower bound on 5500 plan total assets (USD, end of year).

maxBenefitsTotalAssets.description: Inclusive upper bound on 5500 plan total assets (USD, end of year).

benefitsServiceProviderList.description: Service provider name(s) listed on Schedule C of Form 5500.

benefitsServiceProviderCode.description: Single Form 5500 Schedule C service-provider relationship code. Use `benefitsServiceProviderCodes` for multi-code filtering.

benefitsServiceProviderCodes.description: Form 5500 Schedule C service-provider relationship code(s). Matches prospects with any of the listed codes. Superset of `benefitsServiceProviderCode`.

benefitsServiceProviderCompensationMin.description: Minimum service provider compensation amount (USD, Schedule C).

benefitsServiceProviderCompensationMax.description: Maximum service provider compensation amount (USD, Schedule C).

latestBenefitsPlanYear.description: Latest welfare plan year begin date (ISO 8601). Filters on the most recent 5500 welfare filing date.

latestPensionPlanYear.description: Latest pension plan year begin date (ISO 8601).

latestBenefitsSignatoryPolicyBegin.description: Latest welfare signatory first policy begin date (ISO 8601).

latestPensionSignatoryPolicyBegin.description: Latest pension signatory first policy begin date (ISO 8601).

latestBenefitsBrokeragePolicyBegin.description: Latest welfare broker first policy begin date (ISO 8601).

latestPensionBrokeragePolicyBegin.description: Latest pension broker first policy begin date (ISO 8601).

latestBenefitsCarrierPolicyBegin.description: Latest welfare carrier first policy begin date (ISO 8601).

latestPensionCarrierPolicyBegin.description: Latest pension carrier first policy begin date (ISO 8601).

hasOffline5500AiInsights.description: Restrict to prospects with offline 5500 AI insights generated.

hasIrs.description: Restrict to prospects with IRS Form 990 records (nonprofits).

fidelityBondInd.description: Restrict to organizations with a fidelity bond indication on their 990.

has990Contact.description: Restrict to nonprofits with directors/officers listed on the 990.

minIrsTotalRevenue.description: Inclusive lower bound on IRS total revenue (USD).

maxIrsTotalRevenue.description: Inclusive upper bound on IRS total revenue (USD).

minIrsTotalExpenses.description: Inclusive lower bound on IRS total expenses (USD).

maxIrsTotalExpenses.description: Inclusive upper bound on IRS total expenses (USD).

minIrsTotalNetIncome.description: Inclusive lower bound on IRS net income (USD).

maxIrsTotalNetIncome.description: Inclusive upper bound on IRS net income (USD).

minIrsTotalNetAssets.description: Inclusive lower bound on IRS total net assets (USD).

maxIrsTotalNetAssets.description: Inclusive upper bound on IRS total net assets (USD).

minIrsGrossReceipts.description: Inclusive lower bound on IRS gross receipts (USD).

maxIrsGrossReceipts.description: Inclusive upper bound on IRS gross receipts (USD).
